transactions.desc: The Los Angeles Dodgers traded RHP Brady Smith to the Detroit Tigers.
The Atlanta Braves traded LHP Carter Holton to the Kansas City Royals.
The Los Angeles Dodgers traded OF Zyhir Hope to the Detroit Tigers.
The Chicago White Sox traded OF Nolan Jones to the Seattle Mariners.
The Tigers acquired Smith, River Ryan and Zyhir Hope from the Dodgers on Saturday in exchange for Tarik Skubal, Jeff Passan of ESPN.com reports.
The Kansas City Royals traded LHP Bailey Falter to the Atlanta Braves.
The Kansas City Royals traded OF Lane Thomas to the Atlanta Braves.
The Chicago White Sox traded RHP Seranthony Domínguez to the Seattle Mariners.
The Atlanta Braves traded RHP Lucas Braun to the Kansas City Royals.
The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Luis Castillo to the Chicago White Sox.
The Chicago White Sox traded C Boston Smith to the Seattle Mariners.
The Los Angeles Dodgers traded RHP River Ryan to the Detroit Tigers.
The Detroit Tigers traded LHP Tarik Skubal to the Los Angeles Dodgers.
The Dodgers acquired Skubal from the Tigers on Saturday in exchange for Zyhir Hope, River Ryan (hamstring) and Brady Smith, Jeff Passan of ESPN.com reports.
The Pittsburgh Pirates traded OF Luis Cruz to the New York Yankees.
The Dodgers recalled Mills from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Saturday, Maddie Lee of the Los Angeles Times reports.
The Dodgers recalled Hurt from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Saturday, Maddie Lee of the Los Angeles Times reports.
The Dodgers designated Irvin for assignment Saturday, Maddie Lee of the Los Angeles Times reports.
The Giants selected Furman's contract from Triple-A Sacramento on Saturday, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
The Athletics designated Thomas for assignment Saturday.
Huff accepted an outright assignment to Triple-A Norfolk on Saturday after clearing waivers, Rich Dubroff of BaltimoreBaseball.com reports.
France signed a minor-league contract with the Padres on Saturday, Chandler Rome of The Athletic reports.
The Yankees recalled Cruz from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre on Saturday.
The Brewers recalled Stallings from Triple-A Nashville on Saturday.
The Brewers reinstated Lockridge (knee) from the injured list Saturday.
The Athletics optioned Morales to Triple-A Las Vegas on Saturday.
The Athletics selected Bowden's contract from Triple-A Las Vegas on Saturday.
The Angels optioned Johnson to the minors following his start Friday versus Milwaukee, Michael Huntley of MLB.com reports reports.
The Angels called Kerry up from Triple-A Salt Lake on Saturday, Jeff Fletcher of The Orange County Register reports.
The Boston Red Sox traded LHP Jojo Ingrassia to the Detroit Tigers.
